# xcelsior_volume (Resource)

A persistent volume, billed per GB-month from the account's wallet.

`terraform plan` runs every check a create runs (name, quota, size) without creating anything. A rename is made in place; changing `size_gb`, `region` or `encrypted` replaces the volume and **destroys its data**, so protect volumes that hold data with `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`. The API refuses to delete a volume that is attached.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xcelsior_volume" "datasets" {
  name    = "datasets"
  size_gb = 200

  # A change to size_gb, region or encrypted replaces the volume and destroys
  # its data. Guard volumes that hold data.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume name, unique in the account, 1 to 128 characters. Renamed in place.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in GB, 1 to 2000. There is no resize: a change replaces the volume.

### Optional

- `encrypted` (Boolean) Encrypt the volume at rest. Defaults to true.
- `region` (String) Region to create the volume in. Omit to let the platform choose.

### Read-Only

- `attached_to` (String) Instance the volume is attached to, if any.
- `id` (String) The volume id.
- `status` (String) `available`, `attached`, `provisioning` or `error`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xcelsior_volume.datasets <volume-id>
```
